Base URLs:

# Authentication

* API Key (CustomAuthentication)
    - Parameter Name: **Authorization**, in: header. API key header parameter

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-system">System</h1>

## Gets activity log entries.

<a id="opIdGetLogEntries"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/System/ActivityLog/Entries \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /System/ActivityLog/Entries`

<h3 id="gets-activity-log-entries-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32)|false|The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|The maximum number of records to return.|
|minDate|query|string(date-time)|false|The minimum date.|
|maxDate|query|string(date-time)|false|The maximum date.|
|hasUserId|query|boolean|false|Filter log entries if it has user id, or not.|
|name|query|string|false|Filter by name.|
|overview|query|string|false|Filter by overview.|
|shortOverview|query|string|false|Filter by short overview.|
|type|query|string|false|Filter by type.|
|itemId|query|string(uuid)|false|Filter by item id.|
|username|query|string|false|Filter by username.|
|severity|query|string|false|Filter by log severity.|
|sortBy|query|[[ActivityLogSortBy](#schemaactivitylogsortby)]|false|Specify one or more sort orders. Format: SortBy=Name,Type.|
|sortOrder|query|[[SortOrder](#schemasortorder)]|false|Sort Order..|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|severity|Trace|
|severity|Debug|
|severity|Information|
|severity|Warning|
|severity|Error|
|severity|Critical|
|severity|None|
|sortBy|Name|
|sortBy|Overiew|
|sortBy|ShortOverview|
|sortBy|Type|
|sortBy|DateCreated|
|sortBy|Username|
|sortBy|LogSeverity|
|sortOrder|Ascending|
|sortOrder|Descending|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "Items": [
    {
      "Id": 0,
      "Name": "string",
      "Overview": "string",
      "ShortOverview": "string",
      "Type": "string",
      "ItemId": "string",
      "Date": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "UserId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
      "UserPrimaryImageTag": "string",
      "Severity": "Trace"
    }
  ],
  "TotalRecordCount": 0,
  "StartIndex": 0
}
```

<h3 id="gets-activity-log-entries-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Activity log returned.|[ActivityLogEntryQueryResult](#schemaactivitylogentryqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Upload a document.

<a id="opIdLogFile"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/ClientLog/Document \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: text/plain' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  --data-binary '@/path/to/file'
```

`POST /ClientLog/Document`

<h3 id="upload-a-document-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|string(binary)|false|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "FileName": "string"
}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "type": "string",
  "title": "string",
  "status": 0,
  "detail": "string",
  "instance": "string",
  "property1": null,
  "property2": null
}
```

> 413 Response

```json
{
  "type": "string",
  "title": "string",
  "status": 0,
  "detail": "string",
  "instance": "string",
  "property1": null,
  "property2": null
}
```

<h3 id="upload-a-document-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Document saved.|[ClientLogDocumentResponseDto](#schemaclientlogdocumentresponsedto)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Event logging disabled.|[ProblemDetails](#schemaproblemdetails)|
|413|Payload Too Large|Upload size too large.|[ProblemDetails](#schemaproblemdetails)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

<h3 id="updates-application-configuration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|Configuration.|
|» LogFileRetentionDays|body|integer(int32)|false|Gets or sets the number of days we should retain log files.|
|» IsStartupWizardCompleted|body|boolean|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is first run.|
|» CachePath|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the cache path.|
|» PreviousVersion|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the last known version that was ran using the configuration.|
|» PreviousVersionStr|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the stringified PreviousVersion to be stored/loaded,<br>because System.Version itself isn't xml-serializable.|
|» EnableMetrics|body|boolean|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether to enable prometheus metrics exporting.|
|» EnableNormalizedItemByNameIds|body|boolean|false|none|
|» IsPortAuthorized|body|boolean|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is port authorized.|
|» QuickConnectAvailable|body|boolean|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether quick connect is available for use on this server.|
|» EnableCaseSensitiveItemIds|body|boolean|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether [enable case-sensitive item ids].|
|» DisableLiveTvChannelUserDataName|body|boolean|false|none|
|» MetadataPath|body|string|false|Gets or sets the metadata path.|
|» PreferredMetadataLanguage|body|string|false|Gets or sets the preferred metadata language.|
|» MetadataCountryCode|body|string|false|Gets or sets the metadata country code.|
|» SortReplaceCharacters|body|[string]|false|Gets or sets characters to be replaced with a ' ' in strings to create a sort name.|
|» SortRemoveCharacters|body|[string]|false|Gets or sets characters to be removed from strings to create a sort name.|
|» SortRemoveWords|body|[string]|false|Gets or sets words to be removed from strings to create a sort name.|
|» MinResumePct|body|integer(int32)|false|Gets or sets the minimum percentage of an item that must be played in order for playstate to be updated.|
|» MaxResumePct|body|integer(int32)|false|Gets or sets the maximum percentage of an item that can be played while still saving playstate. If this percentage is crossed playstate will be reset to the beginning and the item will be marked watched.|
|» MinResumeDurationSeconds|body|integer(int32)|false|Gets or sets the minimum duration that an item must have in order to be eligible for playstate updates..|
|» MinAudiobookResume|body|integer(int32)|false|Gets or sets the minimum minutes of a book that must be played in order for playstate to be updated.|
|» MaxAudiobookResume|body|integer(int32)|false|Gets or sets the remaining minutes of a book that can be played while still saving playstate. If this percentage is crossed playstate will be reset to the beginning and the item will be marked watched.|
|» InactiveSessionThreshold|body|integer(int32)|false|Gets or sets the threshold in minutes after a inactive session gets closed automatically.<br>If set to 0 the check for inactive sessions gets disabled.|
|» LibraryMonitorDelay|body|integer(int32)|false|Gets or sets the delay in seconds that we will wait after a file system change to try and discover what has been added/removed<br>Some delay is necessary with some items because their creation is not atomic.  It involves the creation of several<br>different directories and files.|
|» LibraryUpdateDuration|body|integer(int32)|false|Gets or sets the duration in seconds that we will wait after a library updated event before executing the library changed notification.|
|» CacheSize|body|integer(int32)|false|Gets or sets the maximum amount of items to cache.|
|» ImageSavingConvention|body|string|false|Gets or sets the image saving convention.|
|» MetadataOptions|body|[[MetadataOptions](#schemametadataoptions)]|false|none|
|» SkipDeserializationForBasicTypes|body|boolean|false|none|
|» ServerName|body|string|false|none|
|» UICulture|body|string|false|none|
|» SaveMetadataHidden|body|boolean|false|none|
|» ContentTypes|body|[[NameValuePair](#schemanamevaluepair)]|false|none|
|» RemoteClientBitrateLimit|body|integer(int32)|false|none|
|» EnableFolderView|body|boolean|false|none|
|» EnableGroupingMoviesIntoCollections|body|boolean|false|none|
|» EnableGroupingShowsIntoCollections|body|boolean|false|none|
|» DisplaySpecialsWithinSeasons|body|boolean|false|none|
|» CodecsUsed|body|[string]|false|none|
|» PluginRepositories|body|[[RepositoryInfo](#schemarepositoryinfo)]|false|none|
|» EnableExternalContentInSuggestions|body|boolean|false|none|
|» ImageExtractionTimeoutMs|body|integer(int32)|false|none|
|» PathSubstitutions|body|[[PathSubstitution](#schemapathsubstitution)]|false|none|
|» EnableSlowResponseWarning|body|boolean|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether slow server responses should be logged as a warning.|
|» SlowResponseThresholdMs|body|integer(int64)|false|Gets or sets the threshold for the slow response time warning in ms.|
|» CorsHosts|body|[string]|false|Gets or sets the cors hosts.|
|» ActivityLogRetentionDays|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|Gets or sets the number of days we should retain activity logs.|
|» LibraryScanFanoutConcurrency|body|integer(int32)|false|Gets or sets the how the library scan fans out.|
|» LibraryMetadataRefreshConcurrency|body|integer(int32)|false|Gets or sets the how many metadata refreshes can run concurrently.|
|» AllowClientLogUpload|body|boolean|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether clients should be allowed to upload logs.|
|» DummyChapterDuration|body|integer(int32)|false|Gets or sets the dummy chapter duration in seconds, use 0 (zero) or less to disable generation altogether.|
|» ChapterImageResolution|body|string|false|Gets or sets the chapter image resolution.|
|» ParallelImageEncodingLimit|body|integer(int32)|false|Gets or sets the limit for parallel image encoding.|
|» CastReceiverApplications|body|[[CastReceiverApplication](#schemacastreceiverapplication)]|false|Gets or sets the list of cast receiver applications.|
|» TrickplayOptions|body|object|false|Gets or sets the trickplay options.|
|» » EnableHwAcceleration|body|boolean|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether or not to use HW acceleration.|
|» » EnableHwEncoding|body|boolean|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether or not to use HW accelerated MJPEG encoding.|
|» » EnableKeyFrameOnlyExtraction|body|boolean|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether to only extract key frames.<br>Significantly faster, but is not compatible with all decoders and/or video files.|
|» » ScanBehavior|body|string|false|Gets or sets the behavior used by trickplay provider on library scan/update.|
|» » ProcessPriority|body|string|false|Gets or sets the process priority for the ffmpeg process.|
|» » Interval|body|integer(int32)|false|Gets or sets the interval, in ms, between each new trickplay image.|
|» » WidthResolutions|body|[integer(int32)]|false|Gets or sets the target width resolutions, in px, to generates preview images for.|
|» » TileWidth|body|integer(int32)|false|Gets or sets number of tile images to allow in X dimension.|
|» » TileHeight|body|integer(int32)|false|Gets or sets number of tile images to allow in Y dimension.|
|» » Qscale|body|integer(int32)|false|Gets or sets the ffmpeg output quality level.|
|» » JpegQuality|body|integer(int32)|false|Gets or sets the jpeg quality to use for image tiles.|
|» » ProcessThreads|body|integer(int32)|false|Gets or sets the number of threads to be used by ffmpeg.|
|» EnableLegacyAuthorization|body|boolean|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether old authorization methods are allowed.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» ImageSavingConvention|Legacy|
|» ImageSavingConvention|Compatible|
|» ChapterImageResolution|MatchSource|
|» ChapterImageResolution|P144|
|» ChapterImageResolution|P240|
|» ChapterImageResolution|P360|
|» ChapterImageResolution|P480|
|» ChapterImageResolution|P720|
|» ChapterImageResolution|P1080|
|» ChapterImageResolution|P1440|
|» ChapterImageResolution|P2160|
|» » ScanBehavior|Blocking|
|» » ScanBehavior|NonBlocking|
|» » ProcessPriority|Normal|
|» » ProcessPriority|Idle|
|» » ProcessPriority|High|
|» » ProcessPriority|RealTime|
|» » ProcessPriority|BelowNormal|
|» » ProcessPriority|AboveNormal|

## Gets a named configuration.

<a id="opIdGetNamedConfiguration"></a>

> Code samples


|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Api key created.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|User authenticated.|[AuthenticationResult](#schemaauthenticationresult)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Authenticates a user with quick connect.

<a id="opIdAuthenticateWithQuickConnect"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Users/AuthenticateWithQuickConnect \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "Secret": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /Users/AuthenticateWithQuickConnect`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "Secret": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="authenticates-a-user-with-quick-connect-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|The Jellyfin.Api.Models.UserDtos.QuickConnectDto request.|
|» Secret|body|string|true|Gets or sets the quick connect secret.|

<h3 id="authenticates-a-user-with-quick-connect-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|User authenticated.|[AuthenticationResult](#schemaauthenticationresult)|
|400|Bad Request|Missing token.|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Initiates the forgot password process for a local user.

<a id="opIdForgotPassword"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Users/ForgotPassword \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "EnteredUsername": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /Users/ForgotPassword`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "EnteredUsername": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="initiates-the-forgot-password-process-for-a-local-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|The forgot password request containing the entered username.|
|» EnteredUsername|body|string|true|Gets or sets the entered username to have its password reset.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "Action": "ContactAdmin",
  "PinFile": "string",
  "PinExpirationDate": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

<h3 id="initiates-the-forgot-password-process-for-a-local-user-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Password reset process started.|[ForgotPasswordResult](#schemaforgotpasswordresult)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Redeems a forgot password pin.

<a id="opIdForgotPasswordPin"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Users/ForgotPassword/Pin \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "Pin": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /Users/ForgotPassword/Pin`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "Pin": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="redeems-a-forgot-password-pin-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|The forgot password pin request containing the entered pin.|
|» Pin|body|string|true|Gets or sets the entered pin to have the password reset.|

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-artist">Artist</h1>

## Gets all artists from a given item, folder, or the entire library.

<a id="opIdGetArtists"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Artists \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Artists`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

<h3 id="gets-all-artists-from-a-given-item-folder-or-the-entire-library-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|minCommunityRating|query|number(double)|false|Optional filter by minimum community rating.|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|searchTerm|query|string|false|Optional. Search term.|
|parentId|query|string(uuid)|false|Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|excludeItemTypes|query|[[BaseItemKind](#schemabaseitemkind)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered out based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|includeItemTypes|query|[[BaseItemKind](#schemabaseitemkind)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|filters|query|[[ItemFilter](#schemaitemfilter)]|false|Optional. Specify additional filters to apply.|
|isFavorite|query|boolean|false|Optional filter by items that are marked as favorite, or not.|
|mediaTypes|query|[[MediaType](#schemamediatype)]|false|Optional filter by MediaType. Allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|genres|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on genre. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|genreIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on genre id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|officialRatings|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on OfficialRating. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|tags|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on tag. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|years|query|[integer(int32)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on production year. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean|false|Optional, include user data.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional, the max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|person|query|string|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person.|
|personIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person ids.|
|personTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, along with Person, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person and PersonType. Allows multiple, comma-delimited.|
|studios|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on studio. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|studioIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on studio id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|User id.|
|nameStartsWithOrGreater|query|string|false|Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally or greater than a given input string.|
|nameStartsWith|query|string|false|Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally than a given input string.|
|nameLessThan|query|string|false|Optional filter by items whose name is equally or lesser than a given input string.|
|sortBy|query|[[ItemSortBy](#schemaitemsortby)]|false|Optional. Specify one or more sort orders, comma delimited.|
|sortOrder|query|[[SortOrder](#schemasortorder)]|false|Sort Order - Ascending,Descending.|
|enableImages|query|boolean|false|Optional, include image information in output.|
|enableTotalRecordCount|query|boolean|false|Total record count.|

<h3 id="gets-all-artists-from-a-given-item-folder-or-the-entire-library-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Artists returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets an artist by name.

<a id="opIdGetArtistByName"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Artists/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Artists/{name}`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

<h3 id="gets-an-artist-by-name-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|path|string|true|Studio name.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.|

<h3 id="gets-an-artist-by-name-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Artist returned.|[BaseItemDto](#schemabaseitemdto)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets all album artists from a given item, folder, or the entire library.

<a id="opIdGetAlbumArtists"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Artists/AlbumArtists \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Artists/AlbumArtists`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

<h3 id="gets-all-album-artists-from-a-given-item-folder-or-the-entire-library-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|minCommunityRating|query|number(double)|false|Optional filter by minimum community rating.|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|searchTerm|query|string|false|Optional. Search term.|
|parentId|query|string(uuid)|false|Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|excludeItemTypes|query|[[BaseItemKind](#schemabaseitemkind)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered out based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|includeItemTypes|query|[[BaseItemKind](#schemabaseitemkind)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|filters|query|[[ItemFilter](#schemaitemfilter)]|false|Optional. Specify additional filters to apply.|
|isFavorite|query|boolean|false|Optional filter by items that are marked as favorite, or not.|
|mediaTypes|query|[[MediaType](#schemamediatype)]|false|Optional filter by MediaType. Allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|genres|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on genre. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|genreIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on genre id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|officialRatings|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on OfficialRating. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|tags|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on tag. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|years|query|[integer(int32)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on production year. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean|false|Optional, include user data.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional, the max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|person|query|string|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person.|
|personIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person ids.|
|personTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, along with Person, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person and PersonType. Allows multiple, comma-delimited.|
|studios|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on studio. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|studioIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on studio id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|User id.|
|nameStartsWithOrGreater|query|string|false|Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally or greater than a given input string.|
|nameStartsWith|query|string|false|Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally than a given input string.|
|nameLessThan|query|string|false|Optional filter by items whose name is equally or lesser than a given input string.|
|sortBy|query|[[ItemSortBy](#schemaitemsortby)]|false|Optional. Specify one or more sort orders, comma delimited.|
|sortOrder|query|[[SortOrder](#schemasortorder)]|false|Sort Order - Ascending,Descending.|
|enableImages|query|boolean|false|Optional, include image information in output.|
|enableTotalRecordCount|query|boolean|false|Total record count.|

|audioCodec|query|string|false|Optional. Specify an audio codec to encode to, e.g. mp3. If omitted the server will auto-select using the url's extension.|
|enableAutoStreamCopy|query|boolean|false|Whether or not to allow automatic stream copy if requested values match the original source. Defaults to true.|

|maxAudioBitDepth|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum audio bit depth.|

|audioChannels|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. Specify a specific number of audio channels to encode to, e.g. 2.|
|maxAudioChannels|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. Specify a maximum number of audio channels to encode to, e.g. 2.|
|profile|query|string|false|Optional. Specify a specific an encoder profile (varies by encoder), e.g. main, baseline, high.|
|level|query|string|false|Optional. Specify a level for the encoder profile (varies by encoder), e.g. 3, 3.1.|
|framerate|query|number(float)|false|Optional. A specific video framerate to encode to, e.g. 23.976. Generally this should be omitted unless the device has specific requirements.|
|maxFramerate|query|number(float)|false|Optional. A specific maximum video framerate to encode to, e.g. 23.976. Generally this should be omitted unless the device has specific requirements.|
|copyTimestamps|query|boolean|false|Whether or not to copy timestamps when transcoding with an offset. Defaults to false.|
|startTimeTicks|query|integer(int64)|false|Optional. Specify a starting offset, in ticks. 1 tick = 10000 ms.|

|height|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The fixed vertical resolution of the encoded video.|
|videoBitRate|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. Specify a video bitrate to encode to, e.g. 500000. If omitted this will be left to encoder defaults.|
|subtitleStreamIndex|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The index of the subtitle stream to use. If omitted no subtitles will be used.|
|subtitleMethod|query|string|false|Optional. Specify the subtitle delivery method.|
|maxRefFrames|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional.|
|maxVideoBitDepth|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum video bit depth.|
|requireAvc|query|boolean|false|Optional. Whether to require avc.|
|deInterlace|query|boolean|false|Optional. Whether to deinterlace the video.|
|requireNonAnamorphic|query|boolean|false|Optional. Whether to require a non anamorphic stream.|
|transcodingMaxAudioChannels|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum number of audio channels to transcode.|
|cpuCoreLimit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The limit of how many cpu cores to use.|

|streamOptions|query|object|false|Optional. The streaming options.|

|transcodingProtocol|query|string|false|Optional. The transcoding protocol.|

|maxAudioBitDepth|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum audio bit depth.|

<h3 id="gets-available-channels-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Channels returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Get channel features.

<a id="opIdGetChannelFeatures"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Channels/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/Features \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Channels/{channelId}/Features`

<h3 id="get-channel-features-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|channelId|path|string(uuid)|true|Channel id.|

## Get channel items.

<a id="opIdGetChannelItems"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Channels/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/Items \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Channels/{channelId}/Items`

<h3 id="get-channel-items-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channelId|path|string(uuid)|true|Channel Id.|
|folderId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Folder Id.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. User Id.|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|sortOrder|query|[[SortOrder](#schemasortorder)]|false|Optional. Sort Order - Ascending,Descending.|
|filters|query|[[ItemFilter](#schemaitemfilter)]|false|Optional. Specify additional filters to apply.|
|sortBy|query|[[ItemSortBy](#schemaitemsortby)]|false|Optional. Specify one or more sort orders, comma delimited. Options: Album, AlbumArtist, Artist, Budget, CommunityRating, CriticRating, DateCreated, DatePlayed, PlayCount, PremiereDate, ProductionYear, SortName, Random, Revenue, Runtime.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|

<h3 id="get-channel-items-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Channel items returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Get all channel features.

<a id="opIdGetAllChannelFeatures"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Channels/Features \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Channels/Features`

> Example responses

```json
]
```

<h3 id="get-all-channel-features-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|All channel features returned.|Inline|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

<h3 id="get-all-channel-features-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[ChannelFeatures](#schemachannelfeatures)]|false|none|none|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets latest channel items.

<a id="opIdGetLatestChannelItems"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Channels/Items/Latest \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Channels/Items/Latest`

<h3 id="gets-latest-channel-items-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. User Id.|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|filters|query|[[ItemFilter](#schemaitemfilter)]|false|Optional. Specify additional filters to apply.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|channelIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. Specify one or more channel id's, comma delimited.|

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-collection">Collection</h1>

## Creates a new collection.

<a id="opIdCreateCollection"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Collections \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /Collections`

<h3 id="creates-a-new-collection-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|query|string|false|The name of the collection.|
|ids|query|[string]|false|Item Ids to add to the collection.|
|parentId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Create the collection within a specific folder.|
|isLocked|query|boolean|false|Whether or not to lock the new collection.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "Id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
}
```

<h3 id="creates-a-new-collection-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Collection created.|[CollectionCreationResult](#schemacollectioncreationresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-genre">Genre</h1>

## Gets all genres from a given item, folder, or the entire library.

<a id="opIdGetGenres"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Genres \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Genres`

<h3 id="gets-all-genres-from-a-given-item-folder-or-the-entire-library-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|searchTerm|query|string|false|The search term.|
|parentId|query|string(uuid)|false|Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|excludeItemTypes|query|[[BaseItemKind](#schemabaseitemkind)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered out based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|includeItemTypes|query|[[BaseItemKind](#schemabaseitemkind)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered in based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|isFavorite|query|boolean|false|Optional filter by items that are marked as favorite, or not.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional, the max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|User id.|
|nameStartsWithOrGreater|query|string|false|Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally or greater than a given input string.|
|nameStartsWith|query|string|false|Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally than a given input string.|
|nameLessThan|query|string|false|Optional filter by items whose name is equally or lesser than a given input string.|
|sortBy|query|[[ItemSortBy](#schemaitemsortby)]|false|Optional. Specify one or more sort orders, comma delimited.|
|sortOrder|query|[[SortOrder](#schemasortorder)]|false|Sort Order - Ascending,Descending.|
|enableImages|query|boolean|false|Optional, include image information in output.|
|enableTotalRecordCount|query|boolean|false|Optional. Include total record count.|

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-image">Image</h1>

## Get artist image by name.

<a id="opIdGetArtistImage"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Artists/string/Images/Primary/0 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /Artists/{name}/Images/{imageType}/{imageIndex}`

<h3 id="get-artist-image-by-name-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|path|string|true|Artist name.|
|imageType|path|string|true|Image type.|
|tag|query|string|false|Optional. Supply the cache tag from the item object to receive strong caching headers.|
|format|query|string|false|Determines the output format of the image - original,gif,jpg,png.|
|maxWidth|query|integer(int32)|false|The maximum image width to return.|
|maxHeight|query|integer(int32)|false|The maximum image height to return.|
|percentPlayed|query|number(double)|false|Optional. Percent to render for the percent played overlay.|
|unplayedCount|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. Unplayed count overlay to render.|
|width|query|integer(int32)|false|The fixed image width to return.|
|height|query|integer(int32)|false|The fixed image height to return.|
|quality|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. Quality setting, from 0-100. Defaults to 90 and should suffice in most cases.|
|fillWidth|query|integer(int32)|false|Width of box to fill.|
|fillHeight|query|integer(int32)|false|Height of box to fill.|
|blur|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. Blur image.|
|backgroundColor|query|string|false|Optional. Apply a background color for transparent images.|
|foregroundLayer|query|string|false|Optional. Apply a foreground layer on top of the image.|
|imageIndex|path|integer(int32)|true|Image index.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|imageType|Primary|
|imageType|Art|
|imageType|Backdrop|
|imageType|Banner|
|imageType|Logo|
|imageType|Thumb|
|imageType|Disc|
|imageType|Box|
|imageType|Screenshot|
|imageType|Menu|
|imageType|Chapter|
|imageType|BoxRear|
|imageType|Profile|
|format|Bmp|
|format|Gif|
|format|Jpg|
|format|Png|
|format|Webp|
|format|Svg|

> Example responses

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "type": "string",
  "title": "string",
  "status": 0,
  "detail": "string",
  "instance": "string",
  "property1": null,
  "property2": null
}
```

<h3 id="get-artist-image-by-name-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Image stream returned.|Inline|
|404|Not Found|Item not found.|[ProblemDetails](#schemaproblemdetails)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

<h3 id="creates-an-instant-playlist-based-on-a-given-album-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Instant playlist returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Item not found.|[ProblemDetails](#schemaproblemdetails)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Creates an instant playlist based on a given artist.

<a id="opIdGetInstantMixFromArtists"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Artists/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/InstantMix \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Artists/{itemId}/InstantMix`

<h3 id="creates-an-instant-playlist-based-on-a-given-artist-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|path|string(uuid)|true|The item id.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|enableImages|query|boolean|false|Optional. Include image information in output.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean|false|Optional. Include user data.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|

<h3 id="creates-an-instant-playlist-based-on-a-given-artist-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Instant playlist returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Item not found.|[ProblemDetails](#schemaproblemdetails)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Creates an instant playlist based on a given item.

<a id="opIdGetInstantMixFromItem"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Items/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/InstantMix \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Items/{itemId}/InstantMix`

<h3 id="creates-an-instant-playlist-based-on-a-given-item-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|path|string(uuid)|true|The item id.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|enableImages|query|boolean|false|Optional. Include image information in output.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean|false|Optional. Include user data.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|

<h3 id="creates-an-instant-playlist-based-on-a-given-item-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Instant playlist returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Item not found.|[ProblemDetails](#schemaproblemdetails)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Creates an instant playlist based on a given genre.

<a id="opIdGetInstantMixFromMusicGenreByName"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/MusicGenres/string/InstantMix \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /MusicGenres/{name}/InstantMix`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

<h3 id="creates-an-instant-playlist-based-on-a-given-genre-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|path|string|true|The genre name.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|enableImages|query|boolean|false|Optional. Include image information in output.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean|false|Optional. Include user data.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Instant playlist returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

```bash
curl 'http://localhost:8096/MusicGenres/InstantMix?id=497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

<aside class="warning">

<h3 id="creates-an-instant-playlist-based-on-a-given-genre-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|query|string(uuid)|true|The item id.|

|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|

|enableUserData|query|boolean|false|Optional. Include user data.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|

<h3 id="creates-an-instant-playlist-based-on-a-given-song-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Instant playlist returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Item not found.|[ProblemDetails](#schemaproblemdetails)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-itemlookup">ItemLookup</h1>

## Get the item's external id info.

<a id="opIdGetExternalIdInfos"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Items/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/ExternalIdInfos \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Items/{itemId}/ExternalIdInfos`

<h3 id="get-the-items-external-id-info-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|path|string(uuid)|true|Item id.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "Name": "string",
    "Key": "string",
    "Type": "Album"
  }
]
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "type": "string",
  "title": "string",
  "status": 0,
  "detail": "string",
  "instance": "string",
  "property1": null,
  "property2": null
}
```

<h3 id="get-the-items-external-id-info-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|External id info retrieved.|Inline|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Item not found.|[ProblemDetails](#schemaproblemdetails)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

<h3 id="get-the-items-external-id-info-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[ExternalIdInfo](#schemaexternalidinfo)]|false|none|none|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Applies search criteria to an item and refreshes metadata.

<a id="opIdApplySearchCriteria"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Items/RemoteSearch/Apply/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "Name": "string",
    "ProviderIds": {
      "property1": "string",
      "property2": "string"
    },
    "ProductionYear": 0,
    "IndexNumber": 0,
    "IndexNumberEnd": 0,
    "ParentIndexNumber": 0,
    "PremiereDate": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "ImageUrl": "string",
    "SearchProviderName": "string",
    "Overview": "string",
    "AlbumArtist": {},
    "Artists": [
      {}
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /Items/RemoteSearch/Apply/{itemId}`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "Name": "string",
  "ProviderIds": {
    "property1": "string",
    "property2": "string"
  },
  "ProductionYear": 0,
  "IndexNumber": 0,
  "IndexNumberEnd": 0,
  "ParentIndexNumber": 0,
  "PremiereDate": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "ImageUrl": "string",
  "SearchProviderName": "string",
  "Overview": "string",
  "AlbumArtist": {},
  "Artists": [
    {}
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="applies-search-criteria-to-an-item-and-refreshes-metadata-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|path|string(uuid)|true|Item id.|
|replaceAllImages|query|boolean|false|Optional. Whether or not to replace all images. Default: True.|
|body|body|object|true|The remote search result.|
|» Name|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the name.|
|» ProviderIds|body|object|false|Gets or sets the provider ids.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string|false|none|
|» ProductionYear|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|Gets or sets the year.|
|» IndexNumber|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|
|» IndexNumberEnd|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|
|» ParentIndexNumber|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|
|» PremiereDate|body|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|
|» ImageUrl|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» SearchProviderName|body|string \| null|false|none|

## Refreshes metadata for an item.

<a id="opIdRefreshItem"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Items/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/Refresh \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /Items/{itemId}/Refresh`

<h3 id="refreshes-metadata-for-an-item-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|path|string(uuid)|true|Item id.|
|metadataRefreshMode|query|string|false|(Optional) Specifies the metadata refresh mode.|
|imageRefreshMode|query|string|false|(Optional) Specifies the image refresh mode.|
|replaceAllMetadata|query|boolean|false|(Optional) Determines if metadata should be replaced. Only applicable if mode is FullRefresh.|
|replaceAllImages|query|boolean|false|(Optional) Determines if images should be replaced. Only applicable if mode is FullRefresh.|
|regenerateTrickplay|query|boolean|false|(Optional) Determines if trickplay images should be replaced. Only applicable if mode is FullRefresh.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|metadataRefreshMode|None|
|metadataRefreshMode|ValidationOnly|
|metadataRefreshMode|Default|
|metadataRefreshMode|FullRefresh|
|imageRefreshMode|None|
|imageRefreshMode|ValidationOnly|
|imageRefreshMode|Default|
|imageRefreshMode|FullRefresh|

> Example responses

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "type": "string",
  "title": "string",
  "status": 0,
  "detail": "string",
  "instance": "string",
  "property1": null,
  "property2": null
}
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|

## Gets items based on a query.

<a id="opIdGetItems"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Items \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Items`

<h3 id="gets-items-based-on-a-query-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|The user id supplied as query parameter; this is required when not using an API key.|
|maxOfficialRating|query|string|false|Optional filter by maximum official rating (PG, PG-13, TV-MA, etc).|
|hasThemeSong|query|boolean|false|Optional filter by items with theme songs.|
|hasThemeVideo|query|boolean|false|Optional filter by items with theme videos.|
|hasSubtitles|query|boolean|false|Optional filter by items with subtitles.|
|hasSpecialFeature|query|boolean|false|Optional filter by items with special features.|
|hasTrailer|query|boolean|false|Optional filter by items with trailers.|
|adjacentTo|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Return items that are siblings of a supplied item.|
|indexNumber|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional filter by index number.|
|parentIndexNumber|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional filter by parent index number.|
|hasParentalRating|query|boolean|false|Optional filter by items that have or do not have a parental rating.|
|isHd|query|boolean|false|Optional filter by items that are HD or not.|
|is4K|query|boolean|false|Optional filter by items that are 4K or not.|
|locationTypes|query|[[LocationType](#schemalocationtype)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on LocationType. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|excludeLocationTypes|query|[[LocationType](#schemalocationtype)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on the LocationType. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|isMissing|query|boolean|false|Optional filter by items that are missing episodes or not.|
|isUnaired|query|boolean|false|Optional filter by items that are unaired episodes or not.|
|minCommunityRating|query|number(double)|false|Optional filter by minimum community rating.|
|minCriticRating|query|number(double)|false|Optional filter by minimum critic rating.|
|minPremiereDate|query|string(date-time)|false|Optional. The minimum premiere date. Format = ISO.|
|minDateLastSaved|query|string(date-time)|false|Optional. The minimum last saved date. Format = ISO.|
|minDateLastSavedForUser|query|string(date-time)|false|Optional. The minimum last saved date for the current user. Format = ISO.|
|maxPremiereDate|query|string(date-time)|false|Optional. The maximum premiere date. Format = ISO.|
|hasOverview|query|boolean|false|Optional filter by items that have an overview or not.|
|hasImdbId|query|boolean|false|Optional filter by items that have an IMDb id or not.|
|hasTmdbId|query|boolean|false|Optional filter by items that have a TMDb id or not.|
|hasTvdbId|query|boolean|false|Optional filter by items that have a TVDb id or not.|
|isMovie|query|boolean|false|Optional filter for live tv movies.|
|isSeries|query|boolean|false|Optional filter for live tv series.|
|isNews|query|boolean|false|Optional filter for live tv news.|
|isKids|query|boolean|false|Optional filter for live tv kids.|
|isSports|query|boolean|false|Optional filter for live tv sports.|
|excludeItemIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered by excluding item ids. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|recursive|query|boolean|false|When searching within folders, this determines whether or not the search will be recursive. true/false.|
|searchTerm|query|string|false|Optional. Filter based on a search term.|
|sortOrder|query|[[SortOrder](#schemasortorder)]|false|Sort Order - Ascending, Descending.|
|parentId|query|string(uuid)|false|Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: Budget, Chapters, DateCreated, Genres, HomePageUrl, IndexOptions, MediaStreams, Overview, ParentId, Path, People, ProviderIds, PrimaryImageAspectRatio, Revenue, SortName, Studios, Taglines.|
|excludeItemTypes|query|[[BaseItemKind](#schemabaseitemkind)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|includeItemTypes|query|[[BaseItemKind](#schemabaseitemkind)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on the item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|filters|query|[[ItemFilter](#schemaitemfilter)]|false|Optional. Specify additional filters to apply. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: IsFolder, IsNotFolder, IsUnplayed, IsPlayed, IsFavorite, IsResumable, Likes, Dislikes.|
|isFavorite|query|boolean|false|Optional filter by items that are marked as favorite, or not.|
|mediaTypes|query|[[MediaType](#schemamediatype)]|false|Optional filter by MediaType. Allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|imageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on those containing image types. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|sortBy|query|[[ItemSortBy](#schemaitemsortby)]|false|Optional. Specify one or more sort orders, comma delimited. Options: Album, AlbumArtist, Artist, Budget, CommunityRating, CriticRating, DateCreated, DatePlayed, PlayCount, PremiereDate, ProductionYear, SortName, Random, Revenue, Runtime.|
|isPlayed|query|boolean|false|Optional filter by items that are played, or not.|
|genres|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on genre. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|officialRatings|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on OfficialRating. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|tags|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on tag. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|years|query|[integer(int32)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on production year. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean|false|Optional, include user data.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional, the max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|person|query|string|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person.|
|personIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person id.|
|personTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, along with Person, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person and PersonType. Allows multiple, comma-delimited.|
|studios|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on studio. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|artists|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on artists. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|excludeArtistIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on artist id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|artistIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified artist id.|
|albumArtistIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified album artist id.|
|contributingArtistIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified contributing artist id.|
|albums|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on album. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|albumIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on album id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|ids|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specific items are needed, specify a list of item id's to retrieve. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|videoTypes|query|[[VideoType](#schemavideotype)]|false|Optional filter by VideoType (videofile, dvd, bluray, iso). Allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|minOfficialRating|query|string|false|Optional filter by minimum official rating (PG, PG-13, TV-MA, etc).|
|isLocked|query|boolean|false|Optional filter by items that are locked.|
|isPlaceHolder|query|boolean|false|Optional filter by items that are placeholders.|
|hasOfficialRating|query|boolean|false|Optional filter by items that have official ratings.|
|collapseBoxSetItems|query|boolean|false|Whether or not to hide items behind their boxsets.|
|minWidth|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. Filter by the minimum width of the item.|
|minHeight|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. Filter by the minimum height of the item.|
|maxWidth|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. Filter by the maximum width of the item.|
|maxHeight|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. Filter by the maximum height of the item.|
|is3D|query|boolean|false|Optional filter by items that are 3D, or not.|
|seriesStatus|query|[[SeriesStatus](#schemaseriesstatus)]|false|Optional filter by Series Status. Allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|nameStartsWithOrGreater|query|string|false|Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally or greater than a given input string.|
|nameStartsWith|query|string|false|Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally than a given input string.|
|nameLessThan|query|string|false|Optional filter by items whose name is equally or lesser than a given input string.|
|studioIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on studio id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|genreIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on genre id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|audioLanguages|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on audio language. This allows multiple, comma delimited values.|
|subtitleLanguages|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on subtitle language. This allows multiple, comma delimited values.|
|enableTotalRecordCount|query|boolean|false|Optional. Enable the total record count.|
|enableImages|query|boolean|false|Optional, include image information in output.|

<h3 id="gets-items-based-on-a-query-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Deletes items from the library and filesystem.

<a id="opIdDeleteItems"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Items \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`DELETE /Items`

<h3 id="deletes-items-from-the-library-and-filesystem-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ids|query|[string(uuid)]|false|The item ids.|

> Example responses

> 401 Response

```json
{
  "type": "string",
  "title": "string",
  "status": 0,
  "detail": "string",
  "instance": "string",
  "property1": null,
  "property2": null
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "type": "string",
  "title": "string",
  "status": 0,
  "detail": "string",
  "instance": "string",
  "property1": null,
  "property2": null
}
```

<h3 id="deletes-items-from-the-library-and-filesystem-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Items deleted.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized access.|[ProblemDetails](#schemaproblemdetails)|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|[ProblemDetails](#schemaproblemdetails)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets items based on a query.

<a id="opIdGetResumeItems"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/UserItems/Resume \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /UserItems/Resume`

<h3 id="gets-items-based-on-a-query-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|The user id.|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32)|false|The start index.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|The item limit.|
|searchTerm|query|string|false|The search term.|
|parentId|query|string(uuid)|false|Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: Budget, Chapters, DateCreated, Genres, HomePageUrl, IndexOptions, MediaStreams, Overview, ParentId, Path, People, ProviderIds, PrimaryImageAspectRatio, Revenue, SortName, Studios, Taglines.|
|mediaTypes|query|[[MediaType](#schemamediatype)]|false|Optional. Filter by MediaType. Allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean|false|Optional. Include user data.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|excludeItemTypes|query|[[BaseItemKind](#schemabaseitemkind)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|includeItemTypes|query|[[BaseItemKind](#schemabaseitemkind)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on the item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|enableTotalRecordCount|query|boolean|false|Optional. Enable the total record count.|
|enableImages|query|boolean|false|Optional. Include image information in output.|
|excludeActiveSessions|query|boolean|false|Optional. Whether to exclude the currently active sessions.|

<h3 id="gets-items-based-on-a-query-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Items returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets an item from a user's library.

<a id="opIdGetItem"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Items/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Items/{itemId}`

<h3 id="gets-an-item-from-a-users-library-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|User id.|
|itemId|path|string(uuid)|true|Item id.|

|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output. This allows multiple, comma delimited. |Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|

|200|OK|Similar items returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

```bash
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

<h3 id="gets-all-parents-of-an-item-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Item parents returned.|Inline|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Item not found.|[ProblemDetails](#schemaproblemdetails)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

<h3 id="gets-all-parents-of-an-item-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[BaseItemDto](#schemabaseitemdto)]|false|none|none|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets the collections that include the specified item.

<a id="opIdGetItemCollections"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Items/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/Collections \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Items/{itemId}/Collections`

<h3 id="gets-the-collections-that-include-the-specified-item-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|path|string(uuid)|true|The item id.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The index of the first record in the output.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|

|fields|AirTime|
|fields|CanDelete|
|fields|CanDownload|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Collections returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|User context missing.|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Item not found.|[ProblemDetails](#schemaproblemdetails)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>


## Gets similar items.

<a id="opIdGetSimilarItems"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Items/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/Similar \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Items/{itemId}/Similar`

<h3 id="gets-similar-items-2-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|path|string(uuid)|true|The item id.|
|excludeArtistIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Exclude artist ids.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: Budget, Chapters, DateCreated, Genres, HomePageUrl, IndexOptions, MediaStreams, Overview, ParentId, Path, People, ProviderIds, PrimaryImageAspectRatio, Revenue, SortName, Studios, Taglines, TrailerUrls.|
