<h3 id="gets-similar-items-2-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Similar items returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Get theme songs and videos for an item.

<a id="opIdGetThemeMedia"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Items/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/ThemeMedia \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Items/{itemId}/ThemeMedia`

<h3 id="get-theme-songs-and-videos-for-an-item-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|path|string(uuid)|true|The item id.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.|
|inheritFromParent|query|boolean|false|Optional. Determines whether or not parent items should be searched for theme media.|
|sortBy|query|[[ItemSortBy](#schemaitemsortby)]|false|Optional. Specify one or more sort orders, comma delimited. Options: Album, AlbumArtist, Artist, Budget, CommunityRating, CriticRating, DateCreated, DatePlayed, PlayCount, PremiereDate, ProductionYear, SortName, Random, Revenue, Runtime.|
|sortOrder|query|[[SortOrder](#schemasortorder)]|false|Optional. Sort Order - Ascending, Descending.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|sortBy|Default|
|sortBy|AiredEpisodeOrder|
|sortBy|Album|
|sortBy|AlbumArtist|
|sortBy|Artist|
|sortBy|DateCreated|
|sortBy|OfficialRating|
|sortBy|DatePlayed|
|sortBy|PremiereDate|
|sortBy|StartDate|
|sortBy|SortName|
|sortBy|Name|
|sortBy|Random|
|sortBy|Runtime|

|sortBy|PlayCount|

|sortBy|SeriesDatePlayed|
|sortBy|ParentIndexNumber|
|sortBy|IndexNumber|
|sortOrder|Ascending|
|sortOrder|Descending|

<h3 id="get-theme-songs-and-videos-for-an-item-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Theme songs and videos returned.|[AllThemeMediaResult](#schemaallthememediaresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Item not found.|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Get theme songs for an item.

<a id="opIdGetThemeSongs"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Items/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/ThemeSongs \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Items/{itemId}/ThemeSongs`

<h3 id="get-theme-songs-for-an-item-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|path|string(uuid)|true|The item id.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.|
|inheritFromParent|query|boolean|false|Optional. Determines whether or not parent items should be searched for theme media.|
|sortBy|query|[[ItemSortBy](#schemaitemsortby)]|false|Optional. Specify one or more sort orders, comma delimited. Options: Album, AlbumArtist, Artist, Budget, CommunityRating, CriticRating, DateCreated, DatePlayed, PlayCount, PremiereDate, ProductionYear, SortName, Random, Revenue, Runtime.|
|sortOrder|query|[[SortOrder](#schemasortorder)]|false|Optional. Sort Order - Ascending, Descending.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|sortBy|Default|
|sortBy|AiredEpisodeOrder|
|sortBy|Album|
|sortBy|AlbumArtist|
|sortBy|Artist|
|sortBy|DateCreated|
|sortBy|OfficialRating|
|sortBy|DatePlayed|
|sortBy|PremiereDate|
|sortBy|StartDate|

<h3 id="get-theme-songs-for-an-item-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Theme songs returned.|[ThemeMediaResult](#schemathememediaresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Item not found.|[ProblemDetails](#schemaproblemdetails)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Get theme videos for an item.

<a id="opIdGetThemeVideos"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Items/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/ThemeVideos \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Items/{itemId}/ThemeVideos`

<h3 id="get-theme-videos-for-an-item-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|path|string(uuid)|true|The item id.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.|
|inheritFromParent|query|boolean|false|Optional. Determines whether or not parent items should be searched for theme media.|
|sortBy|query|[[ItemSortBy](#schemaitemsortby)]|false|Optional. Specify one or more sort orders, comma delimited. Options: Album, AlbumArtist, Artist, Budget, CommunityRating, CriticRating, DateCreated, DatePlayed, PlayCount, PremiereDate, ProductionYear, SortName, Random, Revenue, Runtime.|
|sortOrder|query|[[SortOrder](#schemasortorder)]|false|Optional. Sort Order - Ascending, Descending.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|sortBy|Default|
|sortBy|AiredEpisodeOrder|
|sortBy|Album|
|sortBy|AlbumArtist|
|sortBy|Artist|
|sortBy|DateCreated|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Theme videos returned.|[ThemeMediaResult](#schemathememediaresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Item not found.|[ProblemDetails](#schemaproblemdetails)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Get item counts.

<a id="opIdGetItemCounts"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Items/Counts \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Items/Counts`

<h3 id="get-item-counts-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Get counts from a specific user's library.|
|isFavorite|query|boolean|false|Optional. Get counts of favorite items.|

## Reports that new movies have been added by an external source.

<a id="opIdPostUpdatedMedia"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Library/Media/Updated \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "Updates": [
      {
        "Path": "string",
        "UpdateType": "string"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /Library/Media/Updated`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "Updates": [
    {
      "Path": "string",
      "UpdateType": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

|» Updates|body|[[MediaUpdateInfoPathDto](#schemamediaupdateinfopathdto)]|false|Gets or sets the list of updates.|

<h3 id="gets-similar-items-3-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Similar items returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets similar items.

<a id="opIdGetSimilarShows"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Shows/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/Similar \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Shows/{itemId}/Similar`

<h3 id="gets-similar-items-4-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|path|string(uuid)|true|The item id.|
|excludeArtistIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Exclude artist ids.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: Budget, Chapters, DateCreated, Genres, HomePageUrl, IndexOptions, MediaStreams, Overview, ParentId, Path, People, ProviderIds, PrimaryImageAspectRatio, Revenue, SortName, Studios, Taglines, TrailerUrls.|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Similar items returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets similar items.

<a id="opIdGetSimilarTrailers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Trailers/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/Similar \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Trailers/{itemId}/Similar`

<h3 id="gets-similar-items-5-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|path|string(uuid)|true|The item id.|
|excludeArtistIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Exclude artist ids.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: Budget, Chapters, DateCreated, Genres, HomePageUrl, IndexOptions, MediaStreams, Overview, ParentId, Path, People, ProviderIds, PrimaryImageAspectRatio, Revenue, SortName, Studios, Taglines, TrailerUrls.|

<h3 id="gets-local-trailers-for-an-item-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|An Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.OkResult containing the item's local trailers.|Inline|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

<h3 id="gets-local-trailers-for-an-item-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[BaseItemDto](#schemabaseitemdto)]|false|none|none|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets special features for an item.

<a id="opIdGetSpecialFeatures"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Items/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/SpecialFeatures \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Items/{itemId}/SpecialFeatures`

<h3 id="gets-special-features-for-an-item-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|User id.|
|itemId|path|string(uuid)|true|Item id.|

<h3 id="gets-special-features-for-an-item-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Special features returned.|Inline|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

<h3 id="gets-special-features-for-an-item-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[BaseItemDto](#schemabaseitemdto)]|false|none|none|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets latest media.

<a id="opIdGetLatestMedia"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Items/Latest \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Items/Latest`

<h3 id="gets-latest-media-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|User id.|
|parentId|query|string(uuid)|false|Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|includeItemTypes|query|[[BaseItemKind](#schemabaseitemkind)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|isPlayed|query|boolean|false|Filter by items that are played, or not.|
|enableImages|query|boolean|false|Optional. include image information in output.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. the max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean|false|Optional. include user data.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|Return item limit.|
|groupItems|query|boolean|false|Whether or not to group items into a parent container.|

<h3 id="gets-latest-media-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Latest media returned.|Inline|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

<h3 id="gets-latest-media-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[BaseItemDto](#schemabaseitemdto)]|false|none|none|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets the root folder from a user's library.

<a id="opIdGetRootFolder"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Items/Root \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Items/Root`

<h3 id="gets-the-root-folder-from-a-users-library-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|User id.|

## Updates an item's content type.

<a id="opIdUpdateItemContentType"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Items/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/ContentType \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /Items/{itemId}/ContentType`

<h3 id="updates-an-items-content-type-parameters">Parameters</h3>

<h3 id="gets-available-live-tv-channels-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Available live tv channels returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets a live tv channel.

<a id="opIdGetChannel"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/LiveTv/Channels/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /LiveTv/Channels/{channelId}`

<h3 id="gets-a-live-tv-channel-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channelId|path|string(uuid)|true|Channel id.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Attach user data.|

## Gets available live tv epgs.

<a id="opIdGetLiveTvPrograms"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/LiveTv/Programs \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /LiveTv/Programs`

<h3 id="gets-available-live-tv-epgs-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channelIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|The channels to return guide information for.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Filter by user id.|
|minStartDate|query|string(date-time)|false|Optional. The minimum premiere start date.|
|hasAired|query|boolean|false|Optional. Filter by programs that have completed airing, or not.|
|isAiring|query|boolean|false|Optional. Filter by programs that are currently airing, or not.|
|maxStartDate|query|string(date-time)|false|Optional. The maximum premiere start date.|
|minEndDate|query|string(date-time)|false|Optional. The minimum premiere end date.|
|maxEndDate|query|string(date-time)|false|Optional. The maximum premiere end date.|
|isMovie|query|boolean|false|Optional. Filter for movies.|
|isSeries|query|boolean|false|Optional. Filter for series.|
|isNews|query|boolean|false|Optional. Filter for news.|
|isKids|query|boolean|false|Optional. Filter for kids.|
|isSports|query|boolean|false|Optional. Filter for sports.|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|sortBy|query|[[ItemSortBy](#schemaitemsortby)]|false|Optional. Specify one or more sort orders, comma delimited. Options: Name, StartDate.|
|sortOrder|query|[[SortOrder](#schemasortorder)]|false|Sort Order - Ascending,Descending.|
|genres|query|[string]|false|The genres to return guide information for.|
|genreIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|The genre ids to return guide information for.|
|enableImages|query|boolean|false|Optional. Include image information in output.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean|false|Optional. Include user data.|
|seriesTimerId|query|string|false|Optional. Filter by series timer id.|
|librarySeriesId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Filter by library series id.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|enableTotalRecordCount|query|boolean|false|Retrieve total record count.|

<h3 id="gets-available-live-tv-epgs-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Live tv epgs returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets a live tv program.

<a id="opIdGetProgram"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/LiveTv/Programs/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /LiveTv/Programs/{programId}`

<h3 id="gets-a-live-tv-program-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|programId|path|string|true|Program id.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Attach user data.|

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "Name": "string",
```

<h3 id="gets-a-live-tv-program-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Program returned.|[BaseItemDto](#schemabaseitemdto)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Program not found.|[ProblemDetails](#schemaproblemdetails)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets recommended live tv epgs.

<a id="opIdGetRecommendedPrograms"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/LiveTv/Programs/Recommended \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /LiveTv/Programs/Recommended`

<h3 id="gets-recommended-live-tv-epgs-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. filter by user id.|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|isAiring|query|boolean|false|Optional. Filter by programs that are currently airing, or not.|
|hasAired|query|boolean|false|Optional. Filter by programs that have completed airing, or not.|
|isSeries|query|boolean|false|Optional. Filter for series.|
|isMovie|query|boolean|false|Optional. Filter for movies.|
|isNews|query|boolean|false|Optional. Filter for news.|
|isKids|query|boolean|false|Optional. Filter for kids.|
|isSports|query|boolean|false|Optional. Filter for sports.|
|enableImages|query|boolean|false|Optional. Include image information in output.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|genreIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|The genres to return guide information for.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean|false|Optional. include user data.|
|enableTotalRecordCount|query|boolean|false|Retrieve total record count.|

<h3 id="gets-recommended-live-tv-epgs-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Recommended epgs returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets live tv recordings.

<a id="opIdGetRecordings"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/LiveTv/Recordings \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /LiveTv/Recordings`

<h3 id="gets-live-tv-recordings-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channelId|query|string|false|Optional. Filter by channel id.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Filter by user and attach user data.|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|status|query|string|false|Optional. Filter by recording status.|
|isInProgress|query|boolean|false|Optional. Filter by recordings that are in progress, or not.|
|seriesTimerId|query|string|false|Optional. Filter by recordings belonging to a series timer.|
|enableImages|query|boolean|false|Optional. Include image information in output.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean|false|Optional. Include user data.|
|isMovie|query|boolean|false|Optional. Filter for movies.|
|isSeries|query|boolean|false|Optional. Filter for series.|
|isKids|query|boolean|false|Optional. Filter for kids.|
|isSports|query|boolean|false|Optional. Filter for sports.|
|isNews|query|boolean|false|Optional. Filter for news.|
|isLibraryItem|query|boolean|false|Optional. Filter for is library item.|
|enableTotalRecordCount|query|boolean|false|Optional. Return total record count.|

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|status|New|
|status|InProgress|

<h3 id="gets-live-tv-recordings-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Live tv recordings returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets a live tv recording.

<a id="opIdGetRecording"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/LiveTv/Recordings/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /LiveTv/Recordings/{recordingId}`

<h3 id="gets-a-live-tv-recording-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|recordingId|path|string(uuid)|true|Recording id.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Attach user data.|

<h3 id="gets-a-live-tv-recording-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Recording returned.|[BaseItemDto](#schemabaseitemdto)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Item not found.|[ProblemDetails](#schemaproblemdetails)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Deletes a live tv recording.

<a id="opIdDeleteRecording"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/LiveTv/Recordings/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`DELETE /LiveTv/Recordings/{recordingId}`

<h3 id="deletes-a-live-tv-recording-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|recordingId|path|string(uuid)|true|Recording id.|

> Example responses

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "type": "string",
  "title": "string",
  "status": 0,
  "detail": "string",
  "instance": "string",
  "property1": null,
  "property2": null
}
```

<h3 id="deletes-a-live-tv-recording-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Recording deleted.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Item not found.|[ProblemDetails](#schemaproblemdetails)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

|isScheduled|query|boolean|false|Optional. Filter by timers that are scheduled.|

<h3 id="gets-the-live-tv-timers-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[TimerInfoDtoQueryResult](#schematimerinfodtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|

## Gets a timer.

<a id="opIdGetTimer"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/LiveTv/Timers/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /LiveTv/Timers/{timerId}`

<h3 id="gets-live-playback-media-info-for-an-item-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|path|string(uuid)|true|The item id.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|**Deprecated.** The user id.|
|maxStreamingBitrate|query|integer(int32)|false|**Deprecated.** The maximum streaming bitrate.|
|startTimeTicks|query|integer(int64)|false|**Deprecated.** The start time in ticks.|
|audioStreamIndex|query|integer(int32)|false|**Deprecated.** The audio stream index.|
|subtitleStreamIndex|query|integer(int32)|false|**Deprecated.** The subtitle stream index.|
|maxAudioChannels|query|integer(int32)|false|**Deprecated.** The maximum number of audio channels.|
|mediaSourceId|query|string|false|**Deprecated.** The media source id.|
|liveStreamId|query|string|false|**Deprecated.** The livestream id.|
|autoOpenLiveStream|query|boolean|false|**Deprecated.** Whether to auto open the livestream.|
|enableDirectPlay|query|boolean|false|**Deprecated.** Whether to enable direct play. Default: true.|
|enableDirectStream|query|boolean|false|**Deprecated.** Whether to enable direct stream. Default: true.|
|enableTranscoding|query|boolean|false|**Deprecated.** Whether to enable transcoding. Default: true.|
|allowVideoStreamCopy|query|boolean|false|**Deprecated.** Whether to allow to copy the video stream. Default: true.|
|allowAudioStreamCopy|query|boolean|false|**Deprecated.** Whether to allow to copy the audio stream. Default: true.|
|body|body|object|false|The playback info.|
|» UserId|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|Gets or sets the playback userId.|
|» MaxStreamingBitrate|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|Gets or sets the max streaming bitrate.|
|» StartTimeTicks|body|integer(int64) \| null|false|Gets or sets the start time in ticks.|
|» AudioStreamIndex|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|Gets or sets the audio stream index.|
|» SubtitleStreamIndex|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|Gets or sets the subtitle stream index.|
|» MaxAudioChannels|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|Gets or sets the max audio channels.|
|» MediaSourceId|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the media source id.|
|» LiveStreamId|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the live stream id.|
|» DeviceProfile|body|object \| null|false|A MediaBrowser.Model.Dlna.DeviceProfile represents a set of metadata which determines which content a certain device is able to play.<br><br><br>Specifically, it defines the supported <see cref="P:MediaBrowser.Model.Dlna.DeviceProfile.ContainerProfiles">containers</see> and<br><see cref="P:MediaBrowser.Model.Dlna.DeviceProfile.CodecProfiles">codecs</see> (video and/or audio, including codec profiles and levels)<br>the device is able to direct play (without transcoding or remuxing),<br>as well as which <see cref="P:MediaBrowser.Model.Dlna.DeviceProfile.TranscodingProfiles">containers/codecs to transcode to</see> in case it isn't.|
|» » Name|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the name of this device profile. User profiles must have a unique name.|
|» » Id|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|Gets or sets the unique internal identifier.|
|» » MaxStreamingBitrate|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|Gets or sets the maximum allowed bitrate for all streamed content.|
|» » MaxStaticBitrate|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|Gets or sets the maximum allowed bitrate for statically streamed content (= direct played files).|
|» » MusicStreamingTranscodingBitrate|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|Gets or sets the maximum allowed bitrate for transcoded music streams.|
|» » MaxStaticMusicBitrate|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|Gets or sets the maximum allowed bitrate for statically streamed (= direct played) music files.|
|» » DirectPlayProfiles|body|[[DirectPlayProfile](#schemadirectplayprofile)]|false|Gets or sets the direct play profiles.|
|» » TranscodingProfiles|body|[[TranscodingProfile](#schematranscodingprofile)]|false|Gets or sets the transcoding profiles.|
|» » ContainerProfiles|body|[[ContainerProfile](#schemacontainerprofile)]|false|Gets or sets the container profiles. Failing to meet these optional conditions causes transcoding to occur.|
|» » CodecProfiles|body|[[CodecProfile](#schemacodecprofile)]|false|Gets or sets the codec profiles.|
|» » SubtitleProfiles|body|[[SubtitleProfile](#schemasubtitleprofile)]|false|Gets or sets the subtitle profiles.|
|» EnableDirectPlay|body|boolean \| null|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether to enable direct play.|
|» EnableDirectStream|body|boolean \| null|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether to enable direct stream.|
|» EnableTranscoding|body|boolean \| null|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether to enable transcoding.|
|» AllowVideoStreamCopy|body|boolean \| null|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether to enable video stream copy.|
|» AllowAudioStreamCopy|body|boolean \| null|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether to allow audio stream copy.|
|» AutoOpenLiveStream|body|boolean \| null|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether to auto open the live stream.|
|» AlwaysBurnInSubtitleWhenTranscoding|body|boolean \| null|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether always burn in subtitles when transcoding.|

## Closes a media source.

<a id="opIdCloseLiveStream"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'http://localhost:8096/LiveStreams/Close?liveStreamId=string' \
  -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /LiveStreams/Close`

<h3 id="closes-a-media-source-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|liveStreamId|query|string|true|The livestream id.|

<h3 id="closes-a-media-source-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Livestream closed.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

|» ItemId|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|Gets or sets the item id.|
|» EnableDirectPlay|body|boolean \| null|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether to enable direct play.|
|» EnableDirectStream|body|boolean \| null|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether to enable direct stream.|
|» AlwaysBurnInSubtitleWhenTranscoding|body|boolean \| null|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether always burn in subtitles when transcoding.|
|» DeviceProfile|body|object \| null|false|A MediaBrowser.Model.Dlna.DeviceProfile represents a set of metadata which determines which content a certain device is able to play.<br><br><br>Specifically, it defines the supported <see cref="P:MediaBrowser.Model.Dlna.DeviceProfile.ContainerProfiles">containers</see> and<br><see cref="P:MediaBrowser.Model.Dlna.DeviceProfile.CodecProfiles">codecs</see> (video and/or audio, including codec profiles and levels)<br>the device is able to direct play (without transcoding or remuxing),<br>as well as which <see cref="P:MediaBrowser.Model.Dlna.DeviceProfile.TranscodingProfiles">containers/codecs to transcode to</see> in case it isn't.|
|» » Name|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the name of this device profile. User profiles must have a unique name.|
|» » Id|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|Gets or sets the unique internal identifier.|
|» » MaxStreamingBitrate|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|Gets or sets the maximum allowed bitrate for all streamed content.|
|» » MaxStaticBitrate|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|Gets or sets the maximum allowed bitrate for statically streamed content (= direct played files).|
|» » MusicStreamingTranscodingBitrate|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|Gets or sets the maximum allowed bitrate for transcoded music streams.|
|» » MaxStaticMusicBitrate|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|Gets or sets the maximum allowed bitrate for statically streamed (= direct played) music files.|
|» » DirectPlayProfiles|body|[[DirectPlayProfile](#schemadirectplayprofile)]|false|Gets or sets the direct play profiles.|
|» » TranscodingProfiles|body|[[TranscodingProfile](#schematranscodingprofile)]|false|Gets or sets the transcoding profiles.|
|» » ContainerProfiles|body|[[ContainerProfile](#schemacontainerprofile)]|false|Gets or sets the container profiles. Failing to meet these optional conditions causes transcoding to occur.|
|» » CodecProfiles|body|[[CodecProfile](#schemacodecprofile)]|false|Gets or sets the codec profiles.|
|» » SubtitleProfiles|body|[[SubtitleProfile](#schemasubtitleprofile)]|false|Gets or sets the subtitle profiles.|
|» DirectPlayProtocols|body|[[MediaProtocol](#schemamediaprotocol)]|false|Gets or sets the device play protocols.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» DirectPlayProtocols|File|
|» DirectPlayProtocols|Http|
|» DirectPlayProtocols|Rtmp|
|» DirectPlayProtocols|Rtsp|
|» DirectPlayProtocols|Udp|
|» DirectPlayProtocols|Rtp|
|» DirectPlayProtocols|Ftp|

## Tests the network with a request with the size of the bitrate.

<a id="opIdGetBitrateTestBytes"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Playback/BitrateTest \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Playback/BitrateTest`

<h3 id="tests-the-network-with-a-request-with-the-size-of-the-bitrate-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|size|query|integer(int32)|false|The bitrate. Defaults to 102400.|

|---|---|---|---|---|

|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-mediasegment">MediaSegment</h1>

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/MediaSegments/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-movie">Movie</h1>

<h3 id="gets-movie-recommendations-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Movie recommendations returned.|Inline|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

<h3 id="gets-movie-recommendations-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[RecommendationDto](#schemarecommendationdto)]|false|none|none|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-musicgenre">MusicGenre</h1>

## Gets a music genre, by name.

<a id="opIdGetMusicGenre"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/MusicGenres/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /MusicGenres/{genreName}`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

<h3 id="gets-a-music-genre-by-name-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|genreName|path|string|true|The genre name.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[BaseItemDto](#schemabaseitemdto)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-person">Person</h1>

## Gets all persons.

<a id="opIdGetPersons"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Persons \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Persons`

<h3 id="gets-all-persons-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the response.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|searchTerm|query|string|false|The search term.|
|nameStartsWith|query|string|false|Optional. Filter by items whose name starts with the given input string.|
|nameLessThan|query|string|false|Optional. Filter by items whose name will appear before this value when sorted alphabetically.|
|nameStartsWithOrGreater|query|string|false|Optional. Filter by items whose name will appear after this value when sorted alphabetically.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|filters|query|[[ItemFilter](#schemaitemfilter)]|false|Optional. Specify additional filters to apply.|
|isFavorite|query|boolean|false|Optional filter by items that are marked as favorite, or not. userId is required.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean|false|Optional, include user data.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional, the max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|excludePersonTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified results will be filtered to exclude those containing the specified PersonType. Allows multiple, comma-delimited.|
|personTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified PersonType. Allows multiple, comma-delimited.|
|parentId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Specify this to localize the search to a specific library. Omit to use the root.|
|appearsInItemId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. If specified, person results will be filtered on items related to said persons.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|User id.|
|enableImages|query|boolean|false|Optional, include image information in output.|

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-playlist">Playlist</h1>

## Creates a new playlist.

<a id="opIdCreatePlaylist"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Playlists \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "Name": "string",
    "Ids": [
      "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
    ],
    "UserId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "MediaType": "Unknown",
    "Users": [
      {
        "UserId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
        "CanEdit": true
      }
    ],
    "IsPublic": true
  }'
```

`POST /Playlists`

For backwards compatibility parameters can be sent via Query or Body, with Query having higher precedence.
Query parameters are obsolete.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "Name": "string",
  "Ids": [
    "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
  ],
  "UserId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "MediaType": "Unknown",
  "Users": [
    {
      "UserId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
      "CanEdit": true
    }
  ],
  "IsPublic": true
}
```

<h3 id="creates-a-new-playlist-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|query|string|false|**Deprecated.** The playlist name.|
|ids|query|[string(uuid)]|false|**Deprecated.** The item ids.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|**Deprecated.** The user id.|
|mediaType|query|string|false|**Deprecated.** The media type.|
|body|body|object|false|The create playlist payload.|
|» Name|body|string|true|Gets or sets the name of the new playlist.|
|» Ids|body|[string(uuid)]|false|Gets or sets item ids to add to the playlist.|
|» UserId|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|Gets or sets the user id.|
|» MediaType|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the media type.|
|» Users|body|[[PlaylistUserPermissions](#schemaplaylistuserpermissions)]|false|Gets or sets the playlist users.|
|» IsPublic|body|boolean|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether the playlist is public.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|mediaType|Unknown|
|mediaType|Video|
|mediaType|Audio|
|mediaType|Photo|
|mediaType|Book|
|» MediaType|Unknown|
|» MediaType|Video|
|» MediaType|Audio|
|» MediaType|Photo|
|» MediaType|Book|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "Id": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="creates-a-new-playlist-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Playlist created.|[PlaylistCreationResult](#schemaplaylistcreationresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

## Updates a playlist.

<a id="opIdUpdatePlaylist"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Playlists/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "Name": "string",
    "Ids": [
      "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
    ],
    "Users": [
      {
        "UserId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
        "CanEdit": true
      }
    ],
    "IsPublic": true
  }'
```

`POST /Playlists/{playlistId}`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "Name": "string",
  "Ids": [
    "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
  ],
  "Users": [
    {
      "UserId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
      "CanEdit": true
    }
  ],
  "IsPublic": true
}
```

<h3 id="updates-a-playlist-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|playlistId|path|string(uuid)|true|The playlist id.|
|body|body|object|true|The Jellyfin.Api.Models.PlaylistDtos.UpdatePlaylistDto id.|
|» Name|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the name of the new playlist.|
|» Ids|body|[string(uuid)]|false|Gets or sets item ids of the playlist.|
|» Users|body|[[PlaylistUserPermissions](#schemaplaylistuserpermissions)]|false|Gets or sets the playlist users.|
|» IsPublic|body|boolean \| null|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether the playlist is public.|

## Gets the original items of a playlist.

```bash
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Playlists/{playlistId}/Items`

<h3 id="gets-the-original-items-of-a-playlist-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|enableImages|query|boolean|false|Optional. Include image information in output.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean|false|Optional. Include user data.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|

## Adds items to a playlist.

<a id="opIdAddItemToPlaylist"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Playlists/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/Items \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /Playlists/{playlistId}/Items`

<h3 id="adds-items-to-a-playlist-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|playlistId|path|string(uuid)|true|The playlist id.|
|ids|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Item id, comma delimited.|
|position|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. 0-based index where to place the items or at the end if `null`.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|The userId.|

<h3 id="reports-playback-has-started-within-a-session-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Playback start recorded.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Pings a playback session.

<a id="opIdPingPlaybackSession"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'http://localhost:8096/Sessions/Playing/Ping?playSessionId=string' \
  -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /Sessions/Playing/Ping`

<h3 id="pings-a-playback-session-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|playSessionId|query|string|true|Playback session id.|

<h3 id="pings-a-playback-session-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Playback session pinged.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

|» » CurrentProgram|body|object \| null|false|Gets or sets the current program.|
|» » OriginalLanguage|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» ItemId|body|string(uuid)|false|Gets or sets the item identifier.|
|» SessionId|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the session id.|
|» MediaSourceId|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the media version identifier.|
|» AudioStreamIndex|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|Gets or sets the index of the audio stream.|
|» SubtitleStreamIndex|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|Gets or sets the index of the subtitle stream.|
|» IsPaused|body|boolean|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is paused.|
|» IsMuted|body|boolean|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is muted.|
|» PositionTicks|body|integer(int64) \| null|false|Gets or sets the position ticks.|
|» PlaybackStartTimeTicks|body|integer(int64) \| null|false|none|
|» VolumeLevel|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|Gets or sets the volume level.|
|» Brightness|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|
|» AspectRatio|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» PlayMethod|body|string|false|Gets or sets the play method.|

|» PlaySessionId|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the play session identifier.|

<h3 id="reports-playback-progress-within-a-session-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Playback progress recorded.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

<h3 id="reports-playback-has-stopped-within-a-session-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Playback stop recorded.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets a list of sessions.

<a id="opIdGetSessions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Sessions \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Sessions`

<h3 id="gets-a-list-of-sessions-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|controllableByUserId|query|string(uuid)|false|Filter by sessions that a given user is allowed to remote control.|
|deviceId|query|string|false|Filter by device Id.|
|activeWithinSeconds|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. Filter by sessions that were active in the last n seconds.|

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-studio">Studio</h1>

## Gets all studios from a given item, folder, or the entire library.

<a id="opIdGetStudios"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Studios \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Studios`

<h3 id="gets-all-studios-from-a-given-item-folder-or-the-entire-library-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|searchTerm|query|string|false|Optional. Search term.|
|parentId|query|string(uuid)|false|Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|excludeItemTypes|query|[[BaseItemKind](#schemabaseitemkind)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered out based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|includeItemTypes|query|[[BaseItemKind](#schemabaseitemkind)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|isFavorite|query|boolean|false|Optional filter by items that are marked as favorite, or not.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean|false|Optional, include user data.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional, the max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|User id.|
|nameStartsWithOrGreater|query|string|false|Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally or greater than a given input string.|
|nameStartsWith|query|string|false|Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally than a given input string.|
|nameLessThan|query|string|false|Optional filter by items whose name is equally or lesser than a given input string.|
|enableImages|query|boolean|false|Optional, include image information in output.|
|enableTotalRecordCount|query|boolean|false|Total record count.|

<h3 id="gets-all-studios-from-a-given-item-folder-or-the-entire-library-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Studios returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets a studio by name.

<a id="opIdGetStudio"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Studios/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Studios/{name}`

<h3 id="gets-a-studio-by-name-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|path|string|true|Studio name.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.|

```bash
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /FallbackFont/Fonts`

> Example responses

## Search remote subtitles.

<a id="opIdSearchRemoteSubtitles"></a>

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Items/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/RemoteSearch/Subtitles/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Items/{itemId}/RemoteSearch/Subtitles/{language}`

<h3 id="search-remote-subtitles-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

## Upload an external subtitle file.

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Videos/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/Subtitles \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "Language": "string",
    "Format": "string",
    "IsForced": true,
    "IsHearingImpaired": true,
    "Data": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /Videos/{itemId}/Subtitles`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "Language": "string",
  "Format": "string",
  "IsForced": true,
  "IsHearingImpaired": true,
  "Data": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="upload-an-external-subtitle-file-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|path|string(uuid)|true|The item the subtitle belongs to.|
|body|body|object|true|The request body.|
|» Language|body|string|true|Gets or sets the subtitle language.|
|» Format|body|string|true|Gets or sets the subtitle format.|
|» IsForced|body|boolean|true|Gets or sets a value indicating whether the subtitle is forced.|
|» IsHearingImpaired|body|boolean|true|Gets or sets a value indicating whether the subtitle is for hearing impaired.|
|» Data|body|string|true|Gets or sets the subtitle data.|

<h3 id="finds-movies-and-trailers-similar-to-a-given-trailer-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-trickplay">TrickPlay</h1>

## Gets a trickplay tile image.

<a id="opIdGetTrickplayTileImage"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Videos/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/Trickplay/0/0.jpg \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Videos/{itemId}/Trickplay/{width}/{index}.jpg`

<h3 id="gets-a-trickplay-tile-image-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|path|string(uuid)|true|The item id.|
|width|path|integer(int32)|true|The width of a single tile.|
|index|path|integer(int32)|true|The index of the desired tile.|
|mediaSourceId|query|string(uuid)|false|The media version id, if using an alternate version.|

> Example responses

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "type": "string",
  "title": "string",
  "status": 0,
  "detail": "string",
  "instance": "string",
  "property1": null,
  "property2": null
}
```

<h3 id="gets-a-trickplay-tile-image-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Tile image not found at specified index.|Inline|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|[ProblemDetails](#schemaproblemdetails)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets an image tiles playlist for trickplay.

<a id="opIdGetTrickplayHlsPlaylist"></a>

> Code samples


<h1 id="jellyfin-api-show">Show</h1>

## Gets episodes for a tv season.

<a id="opIdGetEpisodes"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Shows/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/Episodes \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Shows/{seriesId}/Episodes`

<h3 id="gets-episodes-for-a-tv-season-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|seriesId|path|string(uuid)|true|The series id.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|The user id.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: Budget, Chapters, DateCreated, Genres, HomePageUrl, IndexOptions, MediaStreams, Overview, ParentId, Path, People, ProviderIds, PrimaryImageAspectRatio, Revenue, SortName, Studios, Taglines, TrailerUrls.|
|season|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional filter by season number.|
|seasonId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Filter by season id.|
|isMissing|query|boolean|false|Optional. Filter by items that are missing episodes or not.|
|adjacentTo|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Return items that are siblings of a supplied item.|
|startItemId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Skip through the list until a given item is found.|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|enableImages|query|boolean|false|Optional, include image information in output.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional, the max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean|false|Optional. Include user data.|
|sortBy|query|string|false|Optional. Specify one or more sort orders, comma delimited. Options: Album, AlbumArtist, Artist, Budget, CommunityRating, CriticRating, DateCreated, DatePlayed, PlayCount, PremiereDate, ProductionYear, SortName, Random, Revenue, Runtime.|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets seasons for a tv series.

<a id="opIdGetSeasons"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Shows/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/Seasons \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Shows/{seriesId}/Seasons`

<h3 id="gets-seasons-for-a-tv-series-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|seriesId|path|string(uuid)|true|The series id.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|The user id.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: Budget, Chapters, DateCreated, Genres, HomePageUrl, IndexOptions, MediaStreams, Overview, ParentId, Path, People, ProviderIds, PrimaryImageAspectRatio, Revenue, SortName, Studios, Taglines, TrailerUrls.|
|isSpecialSeason|query|boolean|false|Optional. Filter by special season.|
|isMissing|query|boolean|false|Optional. Filter by items that are missing episodes or not.|
|adjacentTo|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Return items that are siblings of a supplied item.|
|enableImages|query|boolean|false|Optional. Include image information in output.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean|false|Optional. Include user data.|

## Gets a list of next up episodes.

<a id="opIdGetNextUp"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Shows/NextUp \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Shows/NextUp`

<h3 id="gets-a-list-of-next-up-episodes-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|The user id of the user to get the next up episodes for.|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|seriesId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Filter by series id.|
|parentId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.|
|enableImages|query|boolean|false|Optional. Include image information in output.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean|false|Optional. Include user data.|
|nextUpDateCutoff|query|string(date-time)|false|Optional. Starting date of shows to show in Next Up section.|
|enableTotalRecordCount|query|boolean|false|Whether to enable the total records count. Defaults to true.|
|enableResumable|query|boolean|false|Whether to include resumable episodes in next up results.|
|enableRewatching|query|boolean|false|Whether to include watched episodes in next up results.|

<h3 id="gets-a-list-of-next-up-episodes-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets a list of upcoming episodes.

<a id="opIdGetUpcomingEpisodes"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Shows/Upcoming \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Shows/Upcoming`

<h3 id="gets-a-list-of-upcoming-episodes-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|The user id of the user to get the upcoming episodes for.|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|parentId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.|
|enableImages|query|boolean|false|Optional. Include image information in output.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean|false|Optional. Include user data.|

|200|OK|OK|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-user">User</h1>

```bash
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-userview">UserView</h1>

## Get user views.

<a id="opIdGetUserViews"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/UserViews \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /UserViews`

<h3 id="get-user-views-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|User id.|
|includeExternalContent|query|boolean|false|Whether or not to include external views such as channels or live tv.|
|presetViews|query|[[CollectionType](#schemacollectiontype)]|false|Preset views.|
|includeHidden|query|boolean|false|Whether or not to include hidden content.|
