<h3 id="gets-additional-parts-for-a-video-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Additional parts returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Removes alternate video sources.

<a id="opIdDeleteAlternateSources"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Videos/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/AlternateSources \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`DELETE /Videos/{itemId}/AlternateSources`

<h3 id="removes-alternate-video-sources-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|path|string(uuid)|true|The item id.|

> Example responses

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "type": "string",
  "title": "string",
  "status": 0,
  "detail": "string",
  "instance": "string",
  "property1": null,
  "property2": null
}
```

<h3 id="removes-alternate-video-sources-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Alternate sources deleted.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Video not found.|[ProblemDetails](#schemaproblemdetails)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets a video stream.

<a id="opIdGetVideoStream"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Videos/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/stream
```

`GET /Videos/{itemId}/stream`

<h3 id="gets-a-video-stream-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|path|string(uuid)|true|The item id.|
|container|query|string|false|The video container. Possible values are: ts, webm, asf, wmv, ogv, mp4, m4v, mkv, mpeg, mpg, avi, 3gp, wmv, wtv, m2ts, mov, iso, flv.|
|static|query|boolean|false|Optional. If true, the original file will be streamed statically without any encoding. Use either no url extension or the original file extension. true/false.|
|params|query|string|false|The streaming parameters.|
|tag|query|string|false|The tag.|
|deviceProfileId|query|string|false|**Deprecated.** Optional. The dlna device profile id to utilize.|
|playSessionId|query|string|false|The play session id.|
|segmentContainer|query|string|false|The segment container.|
|segmentLength|query|integer(int32)|false|The segment length.|
|minSegments|query|integer(int32)|false|The minimum number of segments.|
|mediaSourceId|query|string|false|The media version id, if playing an alternate version.|
|deviceId|query|string|false|The device id of the client requesting. Used to stop encoding processes when needed.|
|audioCodec|query|string|false|Optional. Specify an audio codec to encode to, e.g. mp3. If omitted the server will auto-select using the url's extension.|
|enableAutoStreamCopy|query|boolean|false|Whether or not to allow automatic stream copy if requested values match the original source. Defaults to true.|
|allowVideoStreamCopy|query|boolean|false|Whether or not to allow copying of the video stream url.|
|allowAudioStreamCopy|query|boolean|false|Whether or not to allow copying of the audio stream url.|
|audioSampleRate|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. Specify a specific audio sample rate, e.g. 44100.|
|maxAudioBitDepth|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum audio bit depth.|
|audioBitRate|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. Specify an audio bitrate to encode to, e.g. 128000. If omitted this will be left to encoder defaults.|
|audioChannels|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. Specify a specific number of audio channels to encode to, e.g. 2.|
|maxAudioChannels|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. Specify a maximum number of audio channels to encode to, e.g. 2.|
|profile|query|string|false|Optional. Specify a specific an encoder profile (varies by encoder), e.g. main, baseline, high.|
|level|query|string|false|Optional. Specify a level for the encoder profile (varies by encoder), e.g. 3, 3.1.|
|framerate|query|number(float)|false|Optional. A specific video framerate to encode to, e.g. 23.976. Generally this should be omitted unless the device has specific requirements.|
|maxFramerate|query|number(float)|false|Optional. A specific maximum video framerate to encode to, e.g. 23.976. Generally this should be omitted unless the device has specific requirements.|
|copyTimestamps|query|boolean|false|Whether or not to copy timestamps when transcoding with an offset. Defaults to false.|
|startTimeTicks|query|integer(int64)|false|Optional. Specify a starting offset, in ticks. 1 tick = 10000 ms.|
|width|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The fixed horizontal resolution of the encoded video.|
|height|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The fixed vertical resolution of the encoded video.|
|maxWidth|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum horizontal resolution of the encoded video.|
|maxHeight|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum vertical resolution of the encoded video.|
|videoBitRate|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. Specify a video bitrate to encode to, e.g. 500000. If omitted this will be left to encoder defaults.|
|subtitleStreamIndex|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The index of the subtitle stream to use. If omitted no subtitles will be used.|
|subtitleMethod|query|string|false|Optional. Specify the subtitle delivery method.|
|maxRefFrames|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional.|
|maxVideoBitDepth|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum video bit depth.|
|requireAvc|query|boolean|false|Optional. Whether to require avc.|
|deInterlace|query|boolean|false|Optional. Whether to deinterlace the video.|
|requireNonAnamorphic|query|boolean|false|Optional. Whether to require a non anamorphic stream.|
|transcodingMaxAudioChannels|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The maximum number of audio channels to transcode.|
|cpuCoreLimit|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The limit of how many cpu cores to use.|
|liveStreamId|query|string|false|The live stream id.|
|enableMpegtsM2TsMode|query|boolean|false|Optional. Whether to enable the MpegtsM2Ts mode.|
|videoCodec|query|string|false|Optional. Specify a video codec to encode to, e.g. h264. If omitted the server will auto-select using the url's extension.|
|subtitleCodec|query|string|false|Optional. Specify a subtitle codec to encode to.|
|transcodeReasons|query|string|false|Optional. The transcoding reason.|
|audioStreamIndex|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The index of the audio stream to use. If omitted the first audio stream will be used.|
|videoStreamIndex|query|integer(int32)|false|Optional. The index of the video stream to use. If omitted the first video stream will be used.|
|context|query|string|false|Optional. The MediaBrowser.Model.Dlna.EncodingContext.|
|streamOptions|query|object|false|Optional. The streaming options.|
|enableAudioVbrEncoding|query|boolean|false|Optional. Whether to enable Audio Encoding.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|subtitleMethod|Encode|
|subtitleMethod|Embed|
|subtitleMethod|External|
|subtitleMethod|Hls|
|subtitleMethod|Drop|

<h3 id="get-years-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Year query returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets a year.

<a id="opIdGetYear"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:8096/Years/0 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Years/{year}`

<h3 id="gets-a-year-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|year|path|integer(int32)|true|The year.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.|

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "type": "string",
  "title": "string",
  "status": 0,
  "detail": "string",
  "instance": "string",
  "property1": null,
  "property2": null
}
```

<h3 id="gets-a-year-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Year returned.|[BaseItemDto](#schemabaseitemdto)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Year not found.|[ProblemDetails](#schemaproblemdetails)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently starting or is temporarily not available.|None|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|503|Retry-After|integer|int32|A hint for when to retry the operation in full seconds.|
|503|Message|string|text|A short plain-text reason why the server is not available.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

<!-- backwards compatibility -->

```json
{
  "ServerVersion": "string",
  "BackupEngineVersion": "string",
  "DateCreated": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "Path": "string",
  "Options": {
    "Metadata": true,
    "Trickplay": true,
    "Subtitles": true,
    "Database": true
  }
}
```

Manifest type for backups internal structure.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ServerVersion|string|true|none|Gets or sets the jellyfin version this backup was created with.|
|BackupEngineVersion|string|true|none|Gets or sets the backup engine version this backup was created with.|
|DateCreated|string(date-time)|true|none|Gets or sets the date this backup was created with.|
|Path|string|true|none|Gets or sets the path to the backup on the system.|
|Options|object|true|none|Gets or sets the contents of the backup archive.|

<h2 id="tocS_BackupOptionsDto">BackupOptionsDto</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemabackupoptionsdto"></a>
<a id="schema_BackupOptionsDto"></a>
<a id="tocSbackupoptionsdto"></a>
<a id="tocsbackupoptionsdto"></a>

```json
{
  "Metadata": true,
  "Trickplay": true,
  "Subtitles": true,
  "Database": true
}
```

Defines the optional contents of the backup archive.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Metadata|boolean|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether the archive contains the Metadata contents.|
|Trickplay|boolean|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether the archive contains the Trickplay contents.|
|Subtitles|boolean|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether the archive contains the Subtitle contents.|
|Database|boolean|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether the archive contains the Database contents.|

This is strictly used as a data transfer object from the api layer.
This holds information about a BaseItem in a format that is convenient for the client.

A MediaBrowser.Model.Dlna.DeviceProfile represents a set of metadata which determines which content a certain device is able to play.


Specifically, it defines the supported <see cref="P:MediaBrowser.Model.Dlna.DeviceProfile.ContainerProfiles">containers</see> and
<see cref="P:MediaBrowser.Model.Dlna.DeviceProfile.CodecProfiles">codecs</see> (video and/or audio, including codec profiles and levels)
the device is able to direct play (without transcoding or remuxing),
as well as which <see cref="P:MediaBrowser.Model.Dlna.DeviceProfile.TranscodingProfiles">containers/codecs to transcode to</see> in case it isn't.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Name|string \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the name of this device profile. User profiles must have a unique name.|
|Id|string(uuid) \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the unique internal identifier.|
|MaxStreamingBitrate|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the maximum allowed bitrate for all streamed content.|
|MaxStaticBitrate|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the maximum allowed bitrate for statically streamed content (= direct played files).|
|MusicStreamingTranscodingBitrate|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the maximum allowed bitrate for transcoded music streams.|
|MaxStaticMusicBitrate|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the maximum allowed bitrate for statically streamed (= direct played) music files.|
|DirectPlayProfiles|[[DirectPlayProfile](#schemadirectplayprofile)]|false|none|Gets or sets the direct play profiles.|
|TranscodingProfiles|[[TranscodingProfile](#schematranscodingprofile)]|false|none|Gets or sets the transcoding profiles.|
|ContainerProfiles|[[ContainerProfile](#schemacontainerprofile)]|false|none|Gets or sets the container profiles. Failing to meet these optional conditions causes transcoding to occur.|
|CodecProfiles|[[CodecProfile](#schemacodecprofile)]|false|none|Gets or sets the codec profiles.|
|SubtitleProfiles|[[SubtitleProfile](#schemasubtitleprofile)]|false|none|Gets or sets the subtitle profiles.|

```json
  ],
```

```json
    "string"
  ],
  "IsRemoteIPFilterBlacklist": true
}
```

Defines the MediaBrowser.Common.Net.NetworkConfiguration.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|BaseUrl|string|false|none|Gets or sets a value used to specify the URL prefix that your Jellyfin instance can be accessed at.|
|EnableHttps|boolean|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether to use HTTPS.|
|RequireHttps|boolean|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether the server should force connections over HTTPS.|
|CertificatePath|string|false|none|Gets or sets the filesystem path of an X.509 certificate to use for SSL.|
|CertificatePassword|string|false|none|Gets or sets the password required to access the X.509 certificate data in the file specified by MediaBrowser.Common.Net.NetworkConfiguration.CertificatePath.|
|InternalHttpPort|integer(int32)|false|none|Gets or sets the internal HTTP server port.|
|InternalHttpsPort|integer(int32)|false|none|Gets or sets the internal HTTPS server port.|
|PublicHttpPort|integer(int32)|false|none|Gets or sets the public HTTP port.|
|PublicHttpsPort|integer(int32)|false|none|Gets or sets the public HTTPS port.|
|AutoDiscovery|boolean|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether Autodiscovery is enabled.|
|EnableUPnP|boolean|false|none|**Deprecated.** Gets or sets a value indicating whether to enable automatic port forwarding.|
|EnableIPv4|boolean|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether IPv6 is enabled.|
|EnableIPv6|boolean|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether IPv6 is enabled.|
|EnableRemoteAccess|boolean|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether access from outside of the LAN is permitted.|
|LocalNetworkSubnets|[string]|false|none|Gets or sets the subnets that are deemed to make up the LAN.|
|LocalNetworkAddresses|[string]|false|none|Gets or sets the interface addresses which Jellyfin will bind to. If empty, all interfaces will be used.|
|KnownProxies|[string]|false|none|Gets or sets the known proxies.|
|IgnoreVirtualInterfaces|boolean|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether address names that match MediaBrowser.Common.Net.NetworkConfiguration.VirtualInterfaceNames should be ignored for the purposes of binding.|
|VirtualInterfaceNames|[string]|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating the interface name prefixes that should be ignored. The list can be comma separated and values are case-insensitive. <seealso cref="P:MediaBrowser.Common.Net.NetworkConfiguration.IgnoreVirtualInterfaces" />.|
|EnablePublishedServerUriByRequest|boolean|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether the published server uri is based on information in HTTP requests.|
|PublishedServerUriBySubnet|[string]|false|none|Gets or sets the PublishedServerUriBySubnet<br>Gets or sets PublishedServerUri to advertise for specific subnets.|
|RemoteIPFilter|[string]|false|none|Gets or sets the filter for remote IP connectivity. Used in conjunction with <seealso cref="P:MediaBrowser.Common.Net.NetworkConfiguration.IsRemoteIPFilterBlacklist" />.|
|IsRemoteIPFilterBlacklist|boolean|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether <seealso cref="P:MediaBrowser.Common.Net.NetworkConfiguration.RemoteIPFilter" /> contains a blacklist or a whitelist. Default is a whitelist.|

Playback info dto.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|UserId|string(uuid) \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the playback userId.|
|MaxStreamingBitrate|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the max streaming bitrate.|
|StartTimeTicks|integer(int64) \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the start time in ticks.|
|AudioStreamIndex|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the audio stream index.|
|SubtitleStreamIndex|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the subtitle stream index.|
|MaxAudioChannels|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the max audio channels.|
|MediaSourceId|string \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the media source id.|
|LiveStreamId|string \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the live stream id.|
|DeviceProfile|object \| null|false|none|A MediaBrowser.Model.Dlna.DeviceProfile represents a set of metadata which determines which content a certain device is able to play.<br><br><br>Specifically, it defines the supported <see cref="P:MediaBrowser.Model.Dlna.DeviceProfile.ContainerProfiles">containers</see> and<br><see cref="P:MediaBrowser.Model.Dlna.DeviceProfile.CodecProfiles">codecs</see> (video and/or audio, including codec profiles and levels)<br>the device is able to direct play (without transcoding or remuxing),<br>as well as which <see cref="P:MediaBrowser.Model.Dlna.DeviceProfile.TranscodingProfiles">containers/codecs to transcode to</see> in case it isn't.|
|EnableDirectPlay|boolean \| null|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether to enable direct play.|
|EnableDirectStream|boolean \| null|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether to enable direct stream.|
|EnableTranscoding|boolean \| null|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether to enable transcoding.|
|AllowVideoStreamCopy|boolean \| null|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether to enable video stream copy.|
|AllowAudioStreamCopy|boolean \| null|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether to allow audio stream copy.|
|AutoOpenLiveStream|boolean \| null|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether to auto open the live stream.|
|AlwaysBurnInSubtitleWhenTranscoding|boolean \| null|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether always burn in subtitles when transcoding.|

|PreviousVersion|string \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the last known version that was ran using the configuration.|
|PreviousVersionStr|string \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the stringified PreviousVersion to be stored/loaded,<br>because System.Version itself isn't xml-serializable.|
|EnableMetrics|boolean|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether to enable prometheus metrics exporting.|
|EnableNormalizedItemByNameIds|boolean|false|none|none|
|IsPortAuthorized|boolean|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is port authorized.|
|QuickConnectAvailable|boolean|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether quick connect is available for use on this server.|
|EnableCaseSensitiveItemIds|boolean|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether [enable case-sensitive item ids].|
|DisableLiveTvChannelUserDataName|boolean|false|none|none|
|MetadataPath|string|false|none|Gets or sets the metadata path.|
|PreferredMetadataLanguage|string|false|none|Gets or sets the preferred metadata language.|
|MetadataCountryCode|string|false|none|Gets or sets the metadata country code.|
|SortReplaceCharacters|[string]|false|none|Gets or sets characters to be replaced with a ' ' in strings to create a sort name.|
|SortRemoveCharacters|[string]|false|none|Gets or sets characters to be removed from strings to create a sort name.|
|SortRemoveWords|[string]|false|none|Gets or sets words to be removed from strings to create a sort name.|
|MinResumePct|integer(int32)|false|none|Gets or sets the minimum percentage of an item that must be played in order for playstate to be updated.|
|MaxResumePct|integer(int32)|false|none|Gets or sets the maximum percentage of an item that can be played while still saving playstate. If this percentage is crossed playstate will be reset to the beginning and the item will be marked watched.|
|MinResumeDurationSeconds|integer(int32)|false|none|Gets or sets the minimum duration that an item must have in order to be eligible for playstate updates..|
|MinAudiobookResume|integer(int32)|false|none|Gets or sets the minimum minutes of a book that must be played in order for playstate to be updated.|
|MaxAudiobookResume|integer(int32)|false|none|Gets or sets the remaining minutes of a book that can be played while still saving playstate. If this percentage is crossed playstate will be reset to the beginning and the item will be marked watched.|
|InactiveSessionThreshold|integer(int32)|false|none|Gets or sets the threshold in minutes after a inactive session gets closed automatically.<br>If set to 0 the check for inactive sessions gets disabled.|
|LibraryMonitorDelay|integer(int32)|false|none|Gets or sets the delay in seconds that we will wait after a file system change to try and discover what has been added/removed<br>Some delay is necessary with some items because their creation is not atomic.  It involves the creation of several<br>different directories and files.|
|LibraryUpdateDuration|integer(int32)|false|none|Gets or sets the duration in seconds that we will wait after a library updated event before executing the library changed notification.|
|CacheSize|integer(int32)|false|none|Gets or sets the maximum amount of items to cache.|
|ImageSavingConvention|string|false|none|Gets or sets the image saving convention.|
|MetadataOptions|[[MetadataOptions](#schemametadataoptions)]|false|none|none|
|SkipDeserializationForBasicTypes|boolean|false|none|none|
|ServerName|string|false|none|none|
|UICulture|string|false|none|none|
|SaveMetadataHidden|boolean|false|none|none|

|RemoteClientBitrateLimit|integer(int32)|false|none|none|
|EnableFolderView|boolean|false|none|none|
|EnableGroupingMoviesIntoCollections|boolean|false|none|none|
|EnableGroupingShowsIntoCollections|boolean|false|none|none|
|DisplaySpecialsWithinSeasons|boolean|false|none|none|
|CodecsUsed|[string]|false|none|none|

|EnableExternalContentInSuggestions|boolean|false|none|none|

|SlowResponseThresholdMs|integer(int64)|false|none|Gets or sets the threshold for the slow response time warning in ms.|
|CorsHosts|[string]|false|none|Gets or sets the cors hosts.|
|ActivityLogRetentionDays|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the number of days we should retain activity logs.|
|LibraryScanFanoutConcurrency|integer(int32)|false|none|Gets or sets the how the library scan fans out.|
|LibraryMetadataRefreshConcurrency|integer(int32)|false|none|Gets or sets the how many metadata refreshes can run concurrently.|
|AllowClientLogUpload|boolean|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether clients should be allowed to upload logs.|
|DummyChapterDuration|integer(int32)|false|none|Gets or sets the dummy chapter duration in seconds, use 0 (zero) or less to disable generation altogether.|
|ChapterImageResolution|string|false|none|Gets or sets the chapter image resolution.|
